scope: Operational support for optional recovery data; no formal-candidate acceptance or replacement review loop

findings.issue: Individual group size and growing source bytes were not capped by the staging budget.
findings.correction: Skip groups exceeding64MiB; compare opened identities with sizing; bounded copy and bounded second hash; one extra-byte growth probe;32MiB metadata allowance.
findings.status: corrected; independently verified in the same operational assessment

findings.issue: Destination I/O failures could be mislabeled as source changes, and a partial last file could be left untracked.
findings.correction: Track created destination immediately; destination failures propagate and preserve stage; only observed source disappearance/identity/size/content changes skip and clean the complete attempted private group.
findings.status: corrected; independently verified in the same operational assessment

findings.issue: Initial/post-enumeration trace reads and sizing stats could abort on a donor disappearance outside the source-change handler.
findings.correction: Narrow source-only disappearance handling covers those operations; malformed/unsupported stable evidence still aborts with diagnostics.
findings.status: corrected; independently verified in the same operational assessment

boundaries: No donor repair or source/output mutation
Separate candidate namespaces and no verification record
Own stock full acceptance gates remain mandatory
verification_summary: Assessor verified all three corrections in the frozen command and identified no remaining concrete execution blocker. Static operational assessment only; no capture, compiler, hash tool or candidate approval.
